topic: AI Procurement Answer Boundary Card: 7 Checks Before Reusing Vendor Answers
boundary: Educational operations guide only — not legal, compliance, security certification, audit, procurement, ranking, customer-result, revenue, savings, approval, or guaranteed-performance advice.

checks.owner_question: Which policy, control record, architecture note or owner-approved answer is the source?
checks.safe_action: Do not reuse old text unless the source and owner are still current.

checks.owner_question: Is the buyer asking about security, privacy, AI use, data location, subprocessors, uptime, support or commercial terms?
checks.safe_action: Route mixed questions to the right owner instead of pasting one generic answer.

checks.owner_question: Which statements are already true today, and which are planned, roadmap or conditional?
checks.safe_action: Label planned work clearly and avoid present-tense claims until evidence exists.

checks.owner_question: Could the answer imply legal compliance, audit approval, certification, customer outcome, medical, financial or security guarantee?
checks.safe_action: Use bounded operational language and ask counsel/compliance for risky wording.

checks.owner_question: Who is accountable for approving this answer before it leaves the company?
checks.safe_action: Capture owner, date, source link and approval status in a simple register.

checks.owner_question: What proof can be shared now: public page, redacted screenshot, policy excerpt, SOC report process, or owner note?
checks.safe_action: Attach only shareable, non-secret evidence; never send credentials, keys, logs or customer data.

checks.owner_question: Which answers created follow-up questions, blocker themes or commitments that need internal cleanup?
checks.safe_action: Update the answer bank and next-action owner before the next questionnaire arrives.

safe_scope: Uses source verification, question-fit routing, present-tense evidence control, regulated wording checks, owner approval, shareable evidence links and post-send answer-bank updates; no legal, compliance, audit, certification, ranking, revenue, savings, customer-result, approval or performance guarantees.
